messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - dedicated pool auriga-prod (tenant: auriga) reporting sustained GPU pressure. avg_gpu_util=98%, queue_depth rising, some requests timing out. root_ts=5332102468

akira: taking pager, joining now.

mturner: looking at metrics, linking dashboard: https://internal.metrics/pools/auriga-prod (GPU heatmap + queue).

priya: checking autoscaler config: min=4 max=8 burst_allowed=false. we can enable burst but need infra sign-off.

mturner: logs show repeated enqueue timeouts and 503s for auriga-app at 14:12Z: "upstream enqueue timeout after 2500ms"

akira: quick mitigation proposal: enable short burst (2x) on pool, evict non-prod tenants (perf-tests, analytics-staging), and route low-priority traffic to hosted fallback.

s_jacobs: agree on routing low-priority. can we add a header-based rule to downgrade non-critical requests?

emily-cs: pinging Auriga CSM to notify customer. will keep them informed.

emily-cs: @auriga_contact Hi — we see GPU queueing on your dedicated pool. We're activating emergency mitigations (evictions + burst) and will update in ~15m. No data loss reported.

mturner: snapshotting pool state now:
```
rictl pool get auriga-prod --format=json
```
mturner: sample output: "gpu_util=98.1, queue_depth=142, active_tenants=[auriga,analytics-staging,perf-tests]"

priya: recommendation: enable burst factor=2 for 30m and evict perf-tests + analytics-staging. estimated free GPU ~30%.

akira: @ops-bot request manual burst approval. ops-bot requires 2 SRE lead approvals.

ops-bot: approval request recorded. needs two +1s from SRE leads. @mturner @s_jacobs please respond.

mturner: +1, approve burst 30m.

s_jacobs: +1. also applying router rule: downgrade requests with header X-Client-Priority: low -> hosted-fallback.

priya: executing mitigation commands:
```
rictl pool set-burst auriga-prod --factor=2 --duration=30m
rictl pool evict auriga-prod --selector=tenant in (perf-tests,analytics-staging) --confirm
```

mturner: evictions succeeded, perf-tests and analytics-staging drained. freed ~28% GPU capacity.

akira: monitoring after evictions: queue_depth 142 -> 45 in ~90s. gpu_util down from 98 -> 72%.

incident-bot: customer-impact update: increased latency and intermittent 503s for a small subset of requests (<1%). mitigation in progress, metrics improving.

emily-cs: updated Auriga: "We've enabled emergency burst and offloaded low-priority traffic. Seeing improvements; will keep you posted."

priya: proposed follow-ups: adjust autoscaler for auriga-prod to allow temporary burst windows (suggest: min=4 max=12 burst_window=1h) and mark perf-tests tenant as evictable via tenant labels.

s_jacobs: recommend adding router-side traffic shaping and tenant labels to avoid noisy neighbors in future.

akira: on-call handoff in 30m to @mturner. leaving runbook notes:
- check rictl pool metrics and queue depth
- ensure evicted tenants reschedule to other non-dedicated pools
- if gpu_util > 90% again escalate to infra for node add

mturner: grabbing handoff. will monitor 30m then decide to extend burst or request capacity add.

emily-cs: Auriga asked for RCA timeline within 24h; I'll coordinate with product and eng for follow-up.

priya: creating PD ticket PD-22456 and a runbook PR: "dedicated-pool-noisy-tenant".

akira: :thumbsup: plan to close active mitigation steps in 12m if metrics remain stable.

incident-bot: status updated -> mitigated (monitoring). last_update_ts=5332102542"
